title: LibUsdOracle chainlink branch divides 1e24 by an unchecked oracle price (division-by-zero revert on frozen/broken feed)
description: getTokenPriceFromExternal, encodeType 0x01 (default chainlink) path, returns `uint256(1e24).div(LibChainlinkOracle.getTokenPrice(addr, FOUR_HOUR_TIMEOUT, lookback))`. LibChainlinkOracle.getTokenPrice/getPrice/getTwap are explicitly documented and coded to RETURN 0 (not revert) when the feed is broken, frozen, has a non-positive answer, or times out. There is NO zero-check before the division here (unlike the WETH/WSTETH branches at lines 52/57/63 which guard `if (price == 0) return 0`). When the underlying chainlink feed returns 0, `1e24 / 0` reverts via LibRedundantMath256.div, instead of the documented graceful 0-return contract. This DoSes any peg/minting/convert path that prices an encodeType-0x01 token while its feed is down. Note the inverted-lookback ternary in LibChainlinkOracle.getTokenPrice (lookback>0 -> spot, lookback==0 -> getTwap(...,0)) is a separate oracle-class bug (ARITH-001); the arithmetic-specific issue here is the missing zero guard before inversion.
impact: Division-by-zero revert (DoS) for any non-WETH/WSTETH whitelisted token using the default chainlink oracle when its feed is frozen/broken, propagating to peg, sunrise minting, and convert valuation that call getUsdPrice. Best-practice violation of the documented 0-sentinel contract; severity Low because it requires an external feed outage and only causes a revert (no value extraction).

ite.intent: DoS price-dependent flows (peg, mint, convert) by causing a div-by-zero
ite.technique: Frozen/broken chainlink feed returns 0; 1e24/0 reverts because the chainlink branch omits the zero guard present in the WETH/WSTETH branches
ite.evasion: Documented graceful-0 contract is violated only on this branch; requires feed outage (conditional, not attacker-triggered)

ice_chain.consumer_function: LibUsdOracle.getUsdPrice -> LibWell.getRatiosAndBeanIndex / LibDeltaB / minting price paths
ice_chain.impact: Revert/DoS of peg, mint, and convert valuation for the affected token
